acceptanceCriteria.check: An account with no records exports successfully
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: The response is a CSV carrying only its header row and no data rows

acceptanceCriteria.check: A caller exporting another account is refused
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: The request from a non-owner for another account returns 403 and no CSV body

acceptanceCriteria.check: The owner exporting their own account receives a CSV download
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: The response carries a CSV content type and a filename disposition

openQuestions.question: How large an export may run synchronously before it must be made asynchronous?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: A synchronous export of a large account will hit the request timeout, which changes the endpoint's shape

openQuestions.question: Which records and which columns are included in the export?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: The criteria cannot pin the CSV contents until the included set is decided

assumptions.assumption: An existing authentication mechanism already identifies the owner of the request
assumptions.validationMethod: Check whether the current router exposes the authenticated account on the request

scopeRisks.risk: The export grows into a reporting feature once callers ask for filters
scopeRisks.prevention: Keep the endpoint parameterless and record filter requests as separate scope
